title: Ganesha Ashtakam
intro: Ganesha Ashtakam is a prayer dedicated to Lord Ganesha, the remover of obstacles, to seek His blessings and protection.
description:
Shri Ganeshashtakam
Salutations to Lord Ganesha.
Prayer to Lord Ganesha

O Lambodara, son of Lord Shiva and Lord of the Ganas,
Bestower of wisdom and remover of worldly sorrows.
O Supreme One, worshipped across the three worlds and the wondrous cause of all creation,
Destroyer of obstacles and giver of happiness, I bow to You again and again.

Prayer to Goddess Saraswati

I bow to Goddess Saraswati, the Divine Mother who pervades the entire universe.
I bow to Her who holds the sacred book and embodies the essence of Vedanta.
I bow to Her who is the pure form of Brahman and the Mother of the universe.
I bow to the Divine Goddess who removes sorrow and is the supreme embodiment of pure consciousness.

Shri Ganeshashtakam

I bow to Lord Ganesha, the unborn, pure, attributeless embodiment of knowledge,
The formless Supreme Lord who is the essence of the universe.
He is the auspicious One, worshipped by the whole world and ever pure,
The Bestower of success and fulfillment.

I bow to Lord Ganesha, ever cheerful, the very form of Brahman and the transcendental Fourth State (Turiya).
He is the eternal refuge of all living beings.
He is the source of everlasting bliss, free from all desires,
The Bestower of success and fulfillment.

I bow to Lord Ganesha, the Guru of the wise and the yogis,
The embodiment of the Supreme Truth and the remover of all obstacles.
He is the ever-auspicious Son of Goddess Parvati,
The Bestower of success and fulfillment.

I bow to Lord Ganesha, adorned with sacred Durva grass,
Vermilion, red flowers, sandalwood paste, and beautiful red garments.
He is the eternal embodiment of complete and undivided wisdom,
The Bestower of success and fulfillment.

I bow to Lord Ganesha, who is gentle, incomparable, and worthy of worship.
He is supreme wisdom, eternal happiness, and the embodiment of truth.
He is easily attainable, perfected, and the divine Son of Lord Mahesha (Shiva),
The Bestower of success and fulfillment.

The gods constantly meditate upon Lord Ganesha,
And the Vedas themselves offer Him prayers.
All living beings take refuge in Lord Ganesha,
The Bestower of success and fulfillment.

I bow to Lord Ganesha, who grants righteousness, prosperity, desires, and liberation.
He bestows children, wisdom, and every noble blessing.
He fulfills the wishes of all sincere seekers,
The Bestower of success and fulfillment.

O Lord Ganesha, I always pray to You.
O Lord of Wisdom, please remain ever pleased with me.
Grant me Your divine vision, O Infinite One,
The Bestower of success and fulfillment.

Benefits (Phala Shruti)
Whoever recites this sacred Shri Ganeshashtakam every morning with purity and devotion
Attains happiness and ultimately liberation (Moksha).

Thus ends the Shri Ganeshashtakam composed by Brahmachari Gayatri Swaroop.

faq.a1: Shri Ganeshashtakam is a sacred Sanskrit hymn dedicated to Lord Ganesha. It consists of eight main verses that describe the divine form, wisdom, blessings, and remover-of-obstacles aspect of Lord Ganesha.
faq.q2: What are the benefits of reciting Shri Ganeshashtakam?
faq.a2: Reciting Shri Ganeshashtakam with devotion is believed to bring wisdom, clarity, confidence, success in work, removal of obstacles, and mental peace. According to the Phala Shruti, regular recitation grants happiness and spiritual upliftment.
faq.q3: When should Shri Ganeshashtakam be recited?
faq.a3: It is considered ideal to recite Shri Ganeshashtakam in the morning after bathing and with a pure mind. However, it can be recited at any time with faith and devotion.
faq.a4: Shri Ganeshashtakam can be recited by everyone, including men, women, children, and elders. There are no specific restrictions regarding age or gender.
faq.q5: How many times should Shri Ganeshashtakam be recited?
faq.a5: Generally, reciting it once with devotion is considered sufficient. During special prayers or for specific wishes, devotees may recite it 3, 11, or 21 times according to their faith.
faq.q6: Can Shri Ganeshashtakam be recited during Ganesh Chaturthi?
faq.a6: Yes, reciting Shri Ganeshashtakam during Ganesh Chaturthi, Sankashti Chaturthi, and other auspicious occasions related to Lord Ganesha is considered highly beneficial and sacred.
faq.q7: Does reciting Shri Ganeshashtakam remove obstacles?
faq.a7: Lord Ganesha is known as Vighnaharta (the remover of obstacles). According to religious beliefs, worshipping and praying to Lord Ganesha with devotion helps overcome difficulties and seek success in life.
faq.q8: Are Shri Ganeshashtakam and Ganesh Chalisa the same?
faq.a8: No. Shri Ganeshashtakam is a Sanskrit hymn consisting of eight verses, while Ganesh Chalisa is a devotional composition of forty verses in Hindi/Awadhi. Both are dedicated to praising and worshipping Lord Ganesha.
